JAINA_RELIC_EVEN_MATCH.title: Even Match
JAINA_RELIC_EVEN_MATCH.description: At the start of each combat, gain a Lucky Coin.
JAINA_RELIC_EVEN_MATCH.flavor: An evenly matched duel — victory hangs by a thread.
JAINA_RELIC_EVEN_MATCH_ANCIENT.title: Prying the Opponent's End Turn Button
JAINA_RELIC_EVEN_MATCH_ANCIENT.descripti: At the start of each combat, gain a Lucky Coin and draw 1 card.
JAINA_RELIC_EVEN_MATCH_ANCIENT.flavor: Before your opponent can end their turn, you've already won it.
JAINA_RELIC_ARCANE_AMPLIFIER.title: Arcane Amplifier
JAINA_RELIC_ARCANE_AMPLIFIER.description: Your Hero Power deals 2 extra damage.
JAINA_RELIC_ARCANE_AMPLIFIER.flavor: Arcane energy surges within, and your spells burn ever brighter.
JAINA_RELIC_BOOK_OF_SECRETS.title: Book of Secrets
JAINA_RELIC_BOOK_OF_SECRETS.description: At the start of each combat, randomly gain 3 Mage spells.
JAINA_RELIC_BOOK_OF_SECRETS.flavor: Every page holds a winning spell.
JAINA_RELIC_RUMMAGE_THROUGH_STOCK.title: Rummage Through Stock
JAINA_RELIC_RUMMAGE_THROUGH_STOCK.descri: Whenever you Discover a card on your turn, deal 3 damage to a random enemy.
JAINA_RELIC_RUMMAGE_THROUGH_STOCK.flavor: There's always something useful at the very bottom.
JAINA_RELIC_APPRENTICE_OF_THE_MAGI.title: Apprentice of the Magi
JAINA_RELIC_APPRENTICE_OF_THE_MAGI.descr: At the start of each turn, your first Arcane spell costs 1 less.
JAINA_RELIC_APPRENTICE_OF_THE_MAGI.flavo: A young apprentice's first foray into the arcane is full of surprises.
